title: Why the White House Is Picking AI National Champions and What It Means
description:
The Wall Street Journal reports that the administration plans to designate AI national champions. We examine what the proposal could mean for companies such as Nvidia and Microsoft; the designation and its benefits should not be treated as finalized. Plus, we look at the new UN talks on autonomous weapons and Apple's massive health AI study.

What we covered:
• Trump administration to name Nvidia, Microsoft and OpenAI as AI 'National Champions'
• AP reports UN-backed talks may launch rules for lethal autonomous weapons
• Apple launches the Apple Health AI Usage Study in the United States

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: When you hear 'National Champion' applied to a tech company, do you feel safer or more concerned about market competition?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
